about: The Gradual of the formulary “3rd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Cast your concern upon the Lord, and He will nourish you. When I cried to the Lord, He heard my voice and delivered me from those who draw near to me.

ex.w016: The Missal shortens the psalm. In Psalm 54:19 the deliverance from enemies has its own verb. The full translation supplies “and delivered me” here.
